summary: TWO-WEEK WINDOW (9/25 to 10/9; the 10/2 run died before publishing). The first week looked like a recovery and the second week slid back. WEEK 1 (9/25-10/2): ALTR came back after the one-message week. Fred answered her questions within seconds on 9/26, sought approval and price before a sale for the fourth straight time (she set $600 on a dirty-talk custom), Melissa restarted the weekly leak report, and on 9/30 she asked for MORE work ('I have a lot of new leaks, may we work on this?'). WEEK 2 (10/2-10/9): nothing open moved. Fred went silent from 9/26 13:08 to 10/6 17:25 (10 days), and when he came back he only confirmed one chatter relay. He has still not told her whether the paid 7/21 backlog-live fan ($500 tip) is free, 13 days after 'Will keep you updated!', and the $600 custom was never confirmed as sold. Derrek's 9/30 'Yep' on her new leaks has had no follow-up for 9 days. The call is still not held 42 days after she agreed to it. NEW TRUST PROBLEM: on 10/3 Mica asked her for more reels for the management-run IG and she replied 'I don’t think we’ve ever started an extra IG for me'. Mayson answered 'We did' and posted a Drive link, with no account handle and no results. She did not reply. She was told about this account in April and asked about it on 9/10, and she still does not believe it exists. That is a long-promised deliverable with no written proof, which is one of ALTR's churn signals. HER ASKS NARROWED: 5 substantive asks in week 1 (fan payment details, custom specs, live timing, call scheduling, new leaks) and 0 in week 2. Everything she sent in week 2 was life updates for the chatters (girls' night 10/2, Colorado and birthday trip 10/6, birthday 10/8) plus her correction about the IG. She did not chase the leaks, the call or the live. She left Mayson's call ping, Melissa's intake form, Fred's time-range question and the 10/2 leak report unanswered. PAYMENTS: the Sept 15-30 invoice (issued 10/1, due ~10/8) has no 'sent' from her and no chase from Stephski in the chat, so it is unconfirmed and about a day past due if unpaid. This is the second invoice in a row with no payment message (Aug 15-31 is now 31 days past due and still unreconciled). Receipts are still unconfirmed for the 8/26 and 9/15 payments. Jason's $1,000 (94 days) and Manuel's $600 (140 days) went a fourth window with no mention. No plaintext credentials were posted in this window. Two older ones are still in the chat history: a Facebook password (6/2) and a Link.me login (5/6).
